page.content:
Licensed theme that put minifigure Jedi and brick X-wings in official Star Wars scale.

How LEGO Star Wars connects

  • Topic: LEGO — LEGO Star Wars is the flagship licensed theme of the brick system.
  • Item: Minifigure — LEGO Star Wars translates film characters into minifigures.
  • Concept: System of Play — LEGO Star Wars sets are built on the same System of Play as City and Castle.

What is LEGO Star Wars?

LEGO Star Wars, launched in 1999, was the first major media license on the System of Play: minifigure Luke and Vader, brick Millennium Falcons, and a line that proved licensed sets could sit beside City and Castle.

Key threads lead to LEGO, Minifigure and System of Play.
